responsibility: Contains the shared x86 scheduler policy code that is not specific to one .md automaton file. It defines the generic issue-rate table by tuned processor, dependency helpers for AGI, flags, and exact store/load forwarding, the target-specific latency adjustment routine, multipass DFA lookahead width, and macro-fusion capability and pair-recognition logic for cmp/test or alu plus branch combinations, serving as the common scheduling decision layer used across several x86 microarchitectures.
